content: ईषिका .²1 An elephantʼs eye-ball. Edgerton, the author of <ls>Mātaṅga L.</ls>, however, says that this meaning is wrong and points out that it means, ‘The under surface of the top of the eye-socket of an elephant. ईषिका त्वक्षिकूटकम्’ <ls>Mātaṅga L. 6. 9</ls>. .²2 A painterʼs brush. .²3 A weapon, arrow, dart. .²4 A kind of missile.
